objective: Improve the frozen pairwise performance calibrator without Pos/Neg labels, AUC, channel inputs, or performance metadata leakage.
registered_improvements: Freeze one pairwise linear ranker family instead of selecting a model family per outer fold.
Calibrate each fold decision score against its training-score ECDF before OOF aggregation.
Normalize timestamp and speaker formatting in semantic text.
Use field-aware character and word TF-IDF for candidate content and boundary context.
Add predeclared interactions among the seven Codex quality dimensions.
Boost continuous-percentile pairs with gaps from 10 to 40 points.
Use mapping and timestamp confidence only as training-pair reliability weights.
Keep all performance, channel, URL, label, source, and split metadata out of model inputs.
status_note: The 94 candidates have complete candidate-level text, but no full longform overview or visual evidence. This is exploratory grouped OOF and still requires a fresh untouched holdout.
